dataIdInfo.idAbs:
World Water Bodies represents the open water rivers, lakes, dry salt flats, oceans, and seas of the world.

For complete hydrographic coverage, use this dataset in conjunction with the World Linear Water dataset.
dataIdInfo.idPurp: World Water Bodies provides a basemap layer for the lakes, oceans, seas, large rivers, and dry salt flats of the world.

report.measDesc: The dataset is converted to file geodatabase (FGDB) format using tools in ArcGIS. The geometry is checked, and if needed repaired.
After processing, the dataset is checked for drawing display and number of records and file sizes compared with source materials.

Features are displayed as polygons rather than as lines when the width of the river or lake exceeds 183 meters for more than 600 meters. If the width of the river falls below 60 meters, it is displayed as a line (and is found in World Linear Water).

The World Base Map was derived using Landsat 8, Landsat 7 (Global Land Survey (GLS) 2000 and GLS 2005), and SRTM (Shuttle Radar Topography Mission) as a global base. Landsat 7 provided the horizontal positional accuracy of +/- 50 meters 90% CE, and SRTM ensured that features appropriately fit the topography (i.e., rivers flowed through valleys).

datasetSeries.seriesName: A subset of World Base Map.

prcStep.stepDesc: The following steps were performed by Esri: Extracted the FGDB feature class from the subset of World Base Map. Added field TYPE and calculated its values using the source DFCC code and description fields. Deleted all fields except NAME1, NAME2, NAME3, TYPE, and ISO_CC.
